_comment: Phase-A starter list for the Library ingest (see docs/YOUTUBE-INGEST-PLAN.md).
INDEPENDENT CHANNELS ONLY. Big media orgs (FloTrack, World Athletics, USATF,
LetsRun, CITIUS) were deliberately removed: they out-post everyone, so a
date-sorted feed turns into a wire service, and a media org is not a claimable
profile. Independent channels ARE the marketplace supply — each one is a real
person who can claim their profile in Phase D.
FINDING (2026-08-06): pro athletes DO run active channels — but almost never at
the handle you would guess. @ColeHocker, @SamParsons, @JoeKlecker and
@ClaytonYoung are all namesakes or dead (sneaker unboxings, last uploads
2006-2017). The real ones are @thecolehocker, @joe_klecker and @_Clayton_Young_.
Guessing handles produces a roster of strangers; every entry here was opened and
read before it was added. This is exactly the job the Apify discovery actor does
at scale — see docs/YOUTUBE-INGEST-PLAN.md §4 stage 1.
Real handles are rarely the obvious ones: Cole Hocker is @thecolehocker (not
@ColeHocker, a namesake), Clayton Young is @_Clayton_Young_, Max Jolliffe is
@woah_max (@woahmax is a music channel), and Josh Kerr + Marcus Milione have no
handle at all — only a channelId. Hence the channelId field below.
NO CHANNEL FOUND: Sam Parsons. @sam_parsons is a sneaker channel dormant since
2017 and @ParsonsSam since 2006. He appears to be Instagram/podcast-first.
Also note Marcus MILIONE is spelled with one L.
GAP: no independent Field-event channel found (Tara Davis-Woodhall is the obvious
target — her handle didn't resolve on the guesses tried). Worth a row on David's
sheet, otherwise the Field tab stays thin.
kind:           athlete | creative | media
disciplineHint: fallback when a video title has no discipline keywords.
dormant:        not posting — kept in case they resume, contributes nothing today.
Subscriber counts from the API settled two of these: @nicksymmonds has 1.71M and
is genuinely him (last upload Aug 2024). @GrantFisher has 803 subs, so it is a
namesake, not the Olympic medallist — worth a real lookup on David's sheet.
